annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: April 1 each year following the year of registration
annual_report.late_penalty: $50 late fee after April 1; entity placed 'Not in Good Standing'

state_tax_on_llc.name: Business Profits Tax (BPT)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every business organization incl. sole proprietors and single-member LLCs with gross business income over $109,000 (taxable periods beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 7.5% for taxable periods ending on or after Dec 31, 2023. Filing required even with no profit once gross business income exceeds $109,000. Thresholds indexed biennially.

state_tax_on_llc.name: Business Enterprise Tax (BET)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: businesses with gross business receipts over $298,000 or enterprise value tax base over $298,000 (taxable periods beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Base = compensation paid + interest + dividends. Thresholds indexed biennially.

entity_level_taxes.name: Business Profits Tax (BPT)
entity_level_taxes.notes: New Hampshire taxes S corporations (and LLCs, partnerships, sole proprietors) at entity level; filing threshold gross business income over $109,000.

entity_level_taxes.name: Business Enterprise Tax (BET)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Thresholds $298,000 gross receipts or enterprise value tax base.

personal_exemption.notes: No tax on wages; the Interest and Dividends Tax was repealed for taxable periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None. Business income is instead hit by BPT 7.5% and BET 0.55% at the business level.

sources.title: NH DRA - Repeal of NH Interest and Dividends Tax Now in Effect
sources.quote: repealed for taxable periods beginning on or after January 1, 2025

estimated_tax.required_if: BPT estimated tax of $200 or more, or BET estimated tax of $260 or more (business taxes; no individual income tax)
estimated_tax.notes: Business tax estimates due 15th day of 4th, 6th, 9th and 12th months (calendar year). Penalty if under 90% of the period's liability.

unemployment_2026.notes: 2.7% on first $14,000 per employee, reduced by any quarterly fund balance reduction. No 2026-specific rate notice read.

notable: No income tax on wages or self-employment income, but a sole proprietor or LLC with gross business income over $109,000 owes 7.5% Business Profits Tax (https://www.revenue.nh.gov/resource-center/frequently-asked-questions/business-profits-tax)

Business Enterprise Tax 0.55% on compensation + interest + dividends once receipts or base exceed $298,000 (https://www.revenue.nh.gov/resource-center/frequently-asked-questions/business-enterprise-tax)
Interest and Dividends Tax repealed from 2025 (https://www.revenue.nh.gov/news-and-media/repeal-nh-interest-and-dividends-tax-now-effect)
